title: Cash Discount Price Schedule — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
Discount pricing figures of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs for fills sold for cash. The figures that matter at the register belong to the three Kestrel discount programs; the manufacturer and foundation programs carry no discount pricing and show zero or No throughout.

| Setting | Kestrel Rx Discount Card | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | Manufacturer Copay Card | Manufacturer Bridge Program | Charitable Foundation Copay Grant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Prices Kestrel Value Generics list drugs at fixed prices | No | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Value-list generic, up to 30 days | $0.00 | $5.99 | $5.99 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Value-list generic, 31 to 90 days | $0.00 | $11.99 | $11.99 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Largest days supply priced from the value list | 0 | 90 | 90 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Generic discount (percent off usual and customary) | 15% | 25% | 25% | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Brand discount (percent off usual and customary) | 8% | 15% | 15% | 0% | 0% | 0% |
| Minimum cash price of any discounted fill | $4.00 | $3.00 | $3.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Specialty drugs excluded | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Vaccine discount (percent off the cash price of a cash vaccine) | 0% | 10% | 10% | 0% | 0% | 0% |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Kestrel Value Generics list.** Where the value list is available, a generic on the list is priced at the fixed 30-day price for a fill of up to 30 days and at the fixed 90-day price for a fill of 31 days up to the largest value-list days supply (90 days for both club memberships). The Kestrel Rx Discount Card has no value list.
2. **Generic and brand discounts** are stated as a whole percent off the usual and customary price: 15% generic and 8% brand on the Kestrel Rx Discount Card; 25% generic and 15% brand on both club memberships.
3. **Minimum cash price** — the lowest price charged for any discounted fill: $4.00 on the Kestrel Rx Discount Card, $3.00 on both club memberships.
4. **Specialty drugs** are excluded from the three Kestrel discount programs.
5. **Vaccines** — both club memberships show a 10% discount off the cash price of a vaccine paid in cash; the Kestrel Rx Discount Card shows 0%.

## Hypothetical illustration of the value-list rows

For a hypothetical club member's value-list generic: a 30-day fill is priced $5.99; a 60-day fill falls in the 31-to-90-day band and is priced $11.99; a 90-day fill is also $11.99, since 90 days is the largest value-list days supply.
